ownership.quote: The high-performance file system that connects AI to data. Founded in 2024 by Hunter Leath, Archil has 11 employees based in San Francisco.

stage.quote: Archil has raised $11M in new, Series A capital led by Standard Capital with participation from YCombinator, Felicis, Peak XV partners, Wayfinder Ventures.
stage.note: Company (as Regatta Storage) previously raised a $6.7M seed led by Felicis and Y Combinator (announced 2025-06-02); Series A announced 2026-04-20, less than a year later.

total_funding_usd.basis: Company's own about page and Series A announcement both state total raised to date
total_funding_usd.quote: Archil has raised $18M in funding, including an $11M Series A led by Standard Capital, with backing from Felicis, Y Combinator, General Catalyst, Peak XV, and operators who've built infrastructure at scale.

last_round.quote: Today, I'm excited to share that Archil has raised $11M in new, Series A capital led by Standard Capital with participation from YCombinator, Felicis, Peak XV partners, Wayfinder Ventures.

note: Archil was formerly named Regatta Storage (rebranded per its June 2025 blog post: 'Archil (formerly Regatta Storage) has raised $6.7M...'). Product line evolved from a POSIX cloud filesystem/volume replacement for EBS into persistent sandboxes + serverless execution for AI agents, matching the card's agent-sandbox category. YC directory entry (Fall 2024 batch, founder Hunter Leath, archil.com domain) matches this provider's website; hint confirmed.
